description: Use this to see the external addresses that receive a copy of every inbound email on one inbox. Read-only; requires auth and message_read. Input: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email). Returns {object:"inbox_forwarding", destinations, unverified}. Each destination has id, email, status (pending or verified), verified_at, created_at, updated_at, expires_at, and client_id. The confirmation code is not included. unverified lists the pending rows again. An inbox-scoped key for another inbox returns HTTP 404 inbox_not_found. Pending addresses receive nothing until a human confirms the emailed code with POST /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/forwarding/confirm. There is no MCP tool for that code.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_list_forwarding

outputSchema.description: Auto-forward destinations on this inbox. No confirmation code.

destinations.description: Every destination. status is pending or verified. No confirmation code.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time a pending code expires, or null once verified.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 time the address was confirmed, or null.
